titleNative: 先生日誌 ほむら先生はたぶんモテない
synopsis: Homura-sensei is the frail biology teacher in his track-suit and white lab coat. Hasumi-san is a new home economics teacher, returning to her alma mater to be with him. Their social positions may have changed, but their feelings remain the same. The sweet, awkward romance between them continues, in this new series depicting their love story as adults! (Source: Pixiv Comics, translated) Note: Sekaneko started publishing this manga on her blog on September 14, 2021. On September 2022, the manga got licensed by Kadokawa.

synopsis: In the beginning, this place was filled with someone's memories—sad memories. synopsis: Shinozaki – an utterly ordinary salaryman who has been suffering from a "pain in the neck" – finds his otherwise-typical life suddenly interrupted by a young woman named Yuuyake. According to Yuuyake, her magician grandmother had modified Shinozaki’s body to an extreme degree such that he’s chock-full of machinery inside! …All of which require regular maintenance that Yuuyake will apparently be performing from now on. With that, the slightly offbeat daily life begins, between Shinozaki the salaryman, Yuuyake the magician, and a mysterious creature named Grey! (Source: Pixiv Comics, translated) Note: Chapter count includes 43 main chapters, one epilogue, and 14 other extra and bonus chapters.

title: Hirahira: Kuniyoshi Ichimon Ukiyotan
titleNative: ひらひら 国芳一門浮世譚
synopsis: After spending 15 years in pursuit of his master’s arch-enemy, Tasaka Denpachiro finally catches up with his prey but then decides to drown himself in a river. Tasaka is saved, however, by Utagawa Kuniyoshi, who happens to be passing by. Saying “You may be willing to throw your life away, but I am just as willing to pick it up,” the famed ukiyo-e artist takes Tasaka on as an apprentice. After receiving a new name, Denpachi, he quickly distinguishes himself as a brilliant painter but cannot reveal his unspeakable past to his teacher. (Source: Japan Media Arts Festival Archive)
